high_level_description: stc brand style, a futuristic illuminated tunnel installation at a tech event with 'LEAP' signage.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A geometric blue ceiling with triangular LED-lit patterns, curved walls with illuminated blue and turquoise digital displays, and a dark reflective floor, the tunnel curving slightly to the right in the distance.

elements.desc: Several people in white clothing walking through the tunnel, silhouetted against the illuminated walls.
Large white text displayed on both sides of the tunnel.
